title: Reckoning the Capital Retain a Fiscal Year Contributes to a Membership and Patronage Equity Account
content:
The capital retain for a fiscal year under Membership and Patronage Equity is taken on the volume the allocation notice for that year was posted on together with the crop input spend standing accrued for the year, the crop input spend counting in full and rounded to two decimal places.

The rate taken is the class's own per-unit retain rate, as the class schedule carries it.

The volume so taken is multiplied by that rate, the product rounded to two decimal places, and that product is taken in full and rounded again to two decimal places as the capital retain credited to the member's equity. The retain and every figure behind it are carried to two decimal places, and where a half cent falls to be decided it rounds up.

## The reckoning as a schedule of lines

| Line | Quantity |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | the volume the allocation notice for the fiscal year was posted on |
| 2 | the crop input spend standing accrued for the fiscal year, counting in full and rounded to two decimal places |
| 3 | the volume the retain is taken on, being line 1 together with line 2 |
| 4 | the class's own per-unit retain rate |
| 5 | line 3 multiplied by line 4, rounded to two decimal places |
| 6 | line 5 taken in full and rounded again to two decimal places, which is the capital retain credited |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A membership whose allocation notice for the fiscal year was posted on 18400.00 units, and whose crop input spend standing accrued for the year is 12600.00, is taken on 31000.00 units altogether. At a class per-unit retain rate of 0.003 a unit the product is 93.00, which rounded to two decimal places is 93.00, and taken in full and rounded again is 93.00. That is the capital retain credited to the member's equity for the year.

A second membership, taken on 41250.00 units at the same rate, reaches a product of 123.75 and a credited retain of 123.75.

## The character of the credit

The retain is a capital subscription and not a share of earnings, so it is taken on the volume of business the class lists whether or not the board declares anything for the year.
